title: Wren and the Extraction
author: Astrid Pemberton
blurb: Edmund Kavanagh, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
